Malformed lead; official encoder path is /channel<N>/stream1 not stream[CHANNEL]

notes: Two distinct RTSP path families in the Pelco line: (1) Sarix Pro/Enhanced/IXE single-channel cameras use /stream1 and /stream2 at port 554; multicast variants are /stream1m and /stream2m. (2) NET5500 Series multi-channel encoders use /channel<N>/stream1 and /channel<N>/stream2 where N is 1-16; port must be 554. (3) Sarix Value series cameras use ONVIF-style /media/stream.sdp?profile=Profile100/101/102. RTSP authentication is enabled by default on all models. The leads /1/stream1 and /stream1 are both confirmed: /stream1 for single-channel cameras and /channel1/stream1 (equivalent to /1/stream1) for the encoder channel 1. PDN (pdn.pelco.com) is offline as of 2026; the support portal (support.pelco.com) loads but requires JS — KB article text was confirmed via Google search snippet extraction.
